experiences.position: Founding Engineer · Full-Stack, Android, iOS & AI
description: Built the first playable MVP in week one — AI-narrated stories with characters, dice and selectable models. About 11 weeks later {product} was live on web and Google Play, and submitted to the App Store.

Implemented a spec-driven story engine on one rule: if the same input must give the same output, it's code, not a prompt. Act schema, validation gate, act planner, a deterministic orchestrator — and a safety classifier on every player input.
Shipped the native Android app in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose — streaming chat, Google sign-in, Play Billing, R8 release builds — across ~20 Play releases.
Sole author of the iOS app: blank SwiftUI scaffold to App Store submission in ~12 days at full Android parity, with StoreKit 2, Sign in with Apple and Live Activities.
Put three payment rails — Razorpay, Google Play Billing and StoreKit 2 — behind one coin ledger, with server-side verification, refund and dispute handling, and tax invoices.
Built the 'Split with AI' authoring studio that turns a script or PDF into a multi-act story, plus server-side purchase attribution and analytics across every client.
Managed and optimized all Google Ads campaigns for WoWTV, driving performance marketing strategy across the platform with focus on measurable business outcomes

Monitored and analyzed key performance metrics including Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), conversion funnels (D0-D7), recovery metrics, and other critical KPIs to optimize campaign performance and ROI
Executed data-driven campaign scaling and descaling strategies based on real-time performance analysis and market trends to maximize efficiency and revenue generation
Leveraged advanced analytics and performance data to inform strategic decisions and continuously improve marketing effectiveness across all channels

Led user-centric UI/UX improvements by providing critical design feedback that shaped a more intuitive and engaging mobile application, while also influencing the product roadmap by reworking information architecture for both web and mobile platforms to improve user flow.
Owned product data integrity by collecting, validating, and enriching market information through web crawling, ensuring accurate and reliable product details for end users
